node_scope: Optional Explorer JavaScript tests; only this installed version was tested.

environment.construction: Explicit allowlist; PATH retained for executable discovery; HOME and TMPDIR set to fresh scratch directories.

isolation_boundary: Verification entry points use -I -B. A separate child-style environment probe intentionally omits -I. Unmodified reanalyze.py does not propagate -I to its child processes. Children use the same fresh no-pip virtual environment, sanitized environment, and its explicit analysis-source cwd for module lookup. The virtual environment excludes system site-packages and user site-packages; no third-party distributions are installed. This is environment isolation, not a network or OS security sandbox.

python_child_style_environment_probe.scope: Separate interpreter probe using the same executable and sanitized environment as frozen subprocesses; not instrumentation inside each analyzer.
